meaning:
1) to dwell, reside
1a) (P'al) to dwell
1b) (Pael) to cause to dwell

elsewhere.note: May the God who has caused his name to dwell there overthrow all kings and peoples who stretch out their hand to alter this, to destroy this house of God which…
whose leaves were beautiful, and its fruit plentiful, and in it was food for all; under which the animals of the field lived, and on whose branches the birds…
